info.title: Biblio owned marketplace API
info.description: All chain quantities are decimal strings. Cursor scope includes filters and replay generation. Maximum page size 100; cart/lookup limit 25. Routes and validation are implemented in src/api.mjs; this document inventories public operations, not a generated client.

sourceScope.description: Sources describe returned collections and an explicit collection filter; this page makes no chain-wide account inventory claim.
Sources describe returned collections and an explicit collection filter; this page makes no chain-wide account inventory claim.

post.description: Authenticated operator policy update for a configured or discovered collection. Optional visible boolean changes durable public visibility; hidden moderation wins. Verification is independent, and this route never grants trading or modifies the configured registry.

get.summary: List discovered collection evidence for operators
get.description: Includes unsupported and failed candidates. Does not change public collection visibility or trading policy. Cursors bind chain, state filter and replay generation.

200.description: Snapshot-consistent catalog evidence, source coverage and independent policy fields.

get.summary: Read one discovered collection and its source readiness
get.description: Returns chain/address identity, deployment/classification/decoder evidence, coverage start/checkpoint/hash/gaps/generation, independent indexed/visible/verified/tradable booleans, and readiness for this source. Tradable reflects existing registry/settlement eligibility, not successful preflight. Unknown history or unsupported sources fail readiness.

200.description: Snapshot-consistent catalog evidence, source coverage and independent policy fields.

get.summary: Positive indexed ERC1155 balances for an account
get.description: Additive read endpoint. The existing holdings endpoint remains ERC721-compatible. Quantities and IDs are decimal strings, public visibility is independent of verification/trading, and zero balances are excluded. Queries are generation-scoped indexed holdings, not a chain-wide completeness claim.

sourceScope.description: Sources describe returned collections and an explicit collection filter; this page makes no chain-wide account inventory claim.

400.description: Invalid bounded query or cursor query/generation mismatch.

404.description: Explicitly requested collection is private or restricted.

CollectionCoverage.description: Observed per-source coverage. Nulls and gaps remain unknown; this is not proof of a complete chain-wide NFT inventory.

ReconciliationEvidence.description: Bounded direct RPC sample evidence for this generation. Partial confidence does not prove enumeration or total-supply completeness.

supply.description: Only populated when a supported pinned getter exposes supply; no implied enumeration proof.

verified.description: Operator verification is independent of public visibility and settlement permission.

tokenCount.description: Distinct active token IDs observed under the latest classified NFT standard; retained rows from previous standards are excluded. Not total contract supply.

OperatorBearer.description: Existing operator token; never expose it to browser clients.
